scope: Only fixed S1S2 arch22 template; do not generalize to base-class search or other templates.
atomic_hook: End of S1S2 override CalcNRatio, after original M/R selection and before MatchTemplate returns.
conclusions: S1S2 CalcS1S2BasicBlock assigns M and S2 plus a BMM1-format condition depending only on S2 and D. It does not emit M-dependent core/UB/matmul outputs.
S1S2 CalcNRatio assigns R; its override does not invoke library tiling or emit core/workspace fields.

After the atomic hook, native MatchTemplate calculates D/split flags and UB; DoOpTiling subsequently computes core/tails/outer/multicore/tensor/sparse fields; DoLibApiTiling calls native matmul/softmax/transpose/scalar generators.
The patch selects both factors together only after context and expected-native checks. Rejected selection preserves both original factors.
The ordinary base-class CalcS1S2 search can call SetMatMulTiling early; this patch does not target that implementation. The evidence specifically concerns the overridden S1S2 implementation.
